Great seafood in the Old Quarter
Jul 2023 • Couples
This place has a lot of reviews and comes up whenever you search for seafood. It's easy to see why. Fresh product and cooked perfectly. My wife is a critical judge and loved it. There's a wide range of seafood available. Personal favorites were small clams (cockles maybe) and some grilled prawns. Be warned, you are sitting either in or on the street and the noise of cars/bikes/engines/horns can be a bit irritating. But it's a good feed and there's cold beer too. Well worth a look for seafood lovers.

Crab small and expensive
Jul 2023 • Solo
On arrival, asked if the crab was available - answer yes. Waitress said it would be 10 minutes prep. time. 30 minutes later I asked about the order. Only then was I told they were out of crab and needed to go yo the market, but it was now cooking. Around 10 minutes later it arrived - tasty but so small with the only meat in the claws. At around $30USD, it was way too expensive. I was not impressed overall.
